desc: Select approach: sliding-window order-statistic cost computation plus non-overlapping interval DP.
Implement coordinate compression and Fenwick count/sum trees; slide over nums and compute each window's median cost using lower median and prefix counts/sums.
Implement rolling DP over prefix length i and chosen window count j, with transition min(skip, take window ending at i-1 from prev[i-x] + cost[i-x]).
Add base cases, large INF, guards for i >= x and j <= i//x, and ensure O(n log n + nk) time/memory.
Test on provided examples, edge cases (x=n, k=1, k*x=n, duplicates, negative values), and small random brute-force checks.
